operator_level_dedup: All Vintage Revivals stores and vintagerevivals.de are operated by carou GmbH and count as one supplier legal operator.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current German professional second-hand fashion operator with a Hamburg store and a large current item-level online secondhand catalogue. First-party imprint identifies carou GmbH, HRB 91341 and VAT DE284106078. Current category pages expose more than one thousand secondhand apparel items with prices and add-to-cart actions. First-party terms govern online delivery contracts and the current shipping page explicitly lists Spain among served EU countries. The operator therefore satisfies the direct remote purchase and ordinary Spain-delivery gates and is promoted as VERIFIED_ELIGIBLE.

evidence.finding: First-party imprint identifies carou GmbH, managing director Thomas Böschen, Amtsgericht Darmstadt HRB 91341 and VAT DE284106078.
Current women category identifies secondhand apparel, shows 1,470 items and item-level prices with add-to-cart actions.
Current secondhand dresses/overalls category exposes priced unique garments and add-to-cart actions.
Current shipping page explicitly lists Spain among EU destinations served at ordinary published shipping rates.
Current store page lists Vintage Revivals at Schulterblatt 18, 20357 Hamburg with opening hours.
